Tokens sum all retained completed model messages, including tool loops, excluding classifier/title/compaction and nested tool model usage. Missing history is not estimated as zero. tokenStatistics.note: Totals use retained message.completed official totalTokens only. Missing usage is —; cache and reasoning are not added again. Classification, titles, compaction and nested tools are excluded. Active users and conversations are distinct users and chats with completed messages in the period. Dates use database natural days. Departments and roles reflect current membership, not historical snapshots; multiple roles count once as a combination. Changes compare the previous equal period, with no percentage for zero or unrecorded baselines.
